name: A10-0278/2026 – Nathalie Loiseau – After § 37 – Am 15
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 37a. Expresses grave concern over attempts by the Muslim Brotherhood and its affiliated networks to gain influence in Syria, including through support from foreign actors; calls on the EU and its Member States to counter the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood and its affiliated networks in Syria and to prevent EU funding from supporting the Muslim Brotherhood and other violent extremist networks; calls on the Council to include entities and individuals linked to the Muslim Brotherhood on the EU list of terrorist organisations;
